card.name: Inside syllable-split long words
card.fires_on: Early pieces of a long word that is split into syllables or cut partway, such as dictionary-style pronunciations of medical terms. Also cut pieces of names like Pres(ident), CAL(IF) and FELB(AM)ATE.

modes.label: Syllable-split medical terms
modes.description: A piece inside a hyphenated or dotted pronunciation breakdown of a medical term.

modes.label: Cut-off names and abbreviations
modes.description: A early piece of a longer word, like president or a drug name, that continues in the next piece.

card.writes: It pushes toward the next piece of a word, such as 'icode' or 'iset', and away from endings like 'ção' and 'lier'.
card.plain: It fires when a long word is broken into small chunks, mostly in pronunciation guides for medical terms.
